notes: NOTES pill ab amount ke neeche aata hai, lafzon wali amount kaali aur Total Cash card upar se bara.
Closing checklist — Closing, RMBS, Card aur PMBS tick hon to "Today Closing Complete" dikhega.
Delete popup mein photo/video ka 16:9 preview — swipe, double-tap se bara/chhota, date + din, video Play se khulti hai.
Sale zero ho to "BC00" aayega, amount ho to wese hi.
Staff Attendance mein pichle hafte jis din jo off tha, is hafte usi din wo pehle se off lagega.
Share sheet ki nayi Blue design — neela header, Date + Station ek row mein, Morning/Evening upar-neeche.
Sheet ab upar-neeche kheench kar chhoti-bari hoti hai — jahan chhoro wahin rehti hai.
Station pe tap karke station bhi select kar sakte ho; header ki khaali jagah khatm ki.
